payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_review_records_parent_versions_only_when_a_pair_or_an_unread_parent_exists stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/phases/review.py. The claim was "REVIEW writes `parent-versions.json` and its line exactly when there is a parent pair or an unread parent, whether or not the spec declares wrong versions of its own. With no unread parent the line carries no `; no record read for` tail. The witness drives four cells whose specs declare no criterion. Each diff edits tests/test_p.py. Retired `SP-1` and `SP-2` each have one criterion with one wrong version and its witness `test_guard` there, which the head suite collected. Retired `SP-3` has the same, but its witness is on tests/test_other.py, which the diff leaves alone. `SP-1` and `SP-3` each record one killed version, and `SP-2` has no record. The `tests` gate kills `SP-1`'s version. The cells' `depends_on` are `SP-1`, `SP-2`, `SP-3` and empty, in that order. It asserts each cell ends `READY_FOR_REVIEW`. It asserts the lines `parent wrong versions: 1 chosen, 0 survived, 0 refused, 0 unproven` and `parent wrong versions: 0 chosen, 0 survived, 0 refused, 0 unproven; no record read for SP-2`, and no line for the last two. It asserts the record exists for the first two cells and not the last two.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_session.py::test_a_killed_or_errored_criterion_probe_files_nothing_and_stops_nothing, tests/test_session.py::test_every_probe_a_session_names_is_applied_under_its_own_criterion_and_each_survivor_blocks, tests/test_session.py::test_a_wrong_version_its_witness_survives_is_rebutted_as_a_blocker, tests/test_session.py::test_a_parents_killed_wrong_version_its_witness_now_survives_is_rebutted_as_a_blocker, tests/test_session.py::test_an_edit_that_removes_nothing_is_refused_before_any_witness_reads_it, tests/test_session.py::test_no_inert_pattern_or_unbuilt_tree_refuses_an_edit_and_a_broken_read_orphans, tests/test_session.py::test_a_survivor_whose_whole_suite_cannot_answer_keeps_todays_blocker, tests/test_session.py::test_a_probe_cell_that_stops_is_entered_once_more_for_every_pair_left, tests/test_session.py::test_a_second_stop_files_every_pair_left_as_an_error_naming_the_runtime_error, tests/test_session.py::test_a_criterion_probe_outside_the_specs_touches_is_refused_before_any_cell, tests/test_session.py::test_every_wrong_version_is_recorded_with_its_outcome_beside_the_criterion_probes, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
